 Selection 2 - Max Dowman to Score 
 Fleetwood vs Arsenal - 8pm Tuesday - EFL Cup
 Current Best Price: 6/4 
 For Max Dowman, the Carabao Cup is a really important tournament to show manager Mikel Arteta he is deserving of more minutes. That is especially true with the Gunners missing both Bukayo Saka and Christos Tzolis. That leaves three attackers vying for to two places in Eberechi Eze, Noni Madueke and Dowman.
 In the last round of this competition, it was Dowman who starred with a pair of goals in a 4-2 win over Ipswich. He’ll likely be given free rein once again Tuesday and could use it to bolster his Premier League minutes argument.

 Selection 3 - Over 3.5 Goals 
 Liverpool vs Chelsea - Wednesday 8pm - EFL Cup
 Current Best Price: 6/5 
 The highlight tie of the EFL Cup fourth round comes from Anfield where Liverpool host Chelsea, and goals look to be on the menu. Andoni Iraola’s men have won six of their last seven and there’s been a total of 29 goals fly in at both ends in that time. The Blues’ form may not match that of their rivals, but the goals tally is similar with their 10 games this season seeing a massive 42 strikes.
 It’s likely that both teams will rotate somewhat for this one, as they both did against Premier League opposition in the last round, and those defences could struggle against attackers trying to make a case for starting in league games.

 Selection 4 - Newcastle to Win 
 Everton vs Newcastle - 7:45pm Thursday - EFL Cup
 Current Best Price: 21/10 
 It’s been testing seasons for both teams so far, with Everton having not won in three and only picked up two victories all term, whilst Newcastle have lost three of their last five but did arrest a two-match losing streak with victory at Crystal Palace over the weekend.
 Matthias Jaissle didn’t offer his starters much rest for the trip to Millwall in the last round - hardly surprising considering the Carabao Cup is a legitimate chance at silverware for the club – and another strong lineup looks to be in the offing here. Everton, too, are unlikely to rotate much but the Magpies should be too strong for them.
